purpose: Test whether the public F125W/F814W mosaics identify a PSF-aware circular BCG plus ICL light profile, then propagate a source-traceable Cooke mass-aperture nuisance to the four frozen dynamics bins without using a gravity or lens residual.
disclosure: The Tian one-component n=2.70 and Re=41.4 kpc summaries, the three-star empirical PSF diagnostics, the Molino BCG catalog row, and the nearest SDSS Petrosian row were known before this freeze. No HST BCG cutout, nonparametric radial profile, one- versus two-component fit, ICL fraction, stellar acceleration, kinematic residual, or lens residual had been inspected.

geometry.rationale: Match the frozen circular dynamics and structural-identifiability geometry rather than importing a lens-model ellipticity convention.

mask.base_rule: Mask every non-BCG Molino catalog source by an ellipse with semiaxes max(4 pixels, 3 times catalog a) and max(4 pixels, 3 times catalog b), using the catalog theta convention; also mask non-finite pixels and non-positive weights.

nonparametric_profile.radial_edges: zero followed by 60 logarithmically spaced edges from 0.065 to 30 arcsec
nonparametric_profile.estimator: inverse-variance mean within each unmasked sector and radial bin
nonparametric_profile.covariance: sector bootstrap covariance plus the diagonal inverse-weight variance multiplied by 1.15 squared for the CLASH drizzle correlated-noise allowance
nonparametric_profile.whitening_regularization: shrink the joint covariance 5 percent toward its diagonal, then floor eigenvalues at 1e-6 times the median positive diagonal variance

psf_forward_model.convolution: native 0.065-arcsec two-dimensional FFT convolution before circular radial binning
psf_forward_model.sensitivity: repeat with all three empirical leave-one-star-out PSFs in each band

candidate_models.one_component: one circular Sersic profile with shared Re and n across F125W/F814W, independent band amplitudes, and independent constant skies
candidate_models.two_component: two co-centered circular Sersic profiles with shared component Re and n across bands, independent band amplitudes, independent constant skies, and the ordering Re_inner < Re_outer
candidate_models.optimizer: bounded scipy least_squares with 20 deterministic multistarts per model and fit variant
candidate_models.radial_cross_validation: two folds of interleaved radial bins; skies and all structural parameters are refit on each training fold

component_identifiability_gate.failure_response: Retain the nonparametric total-light profile and report BCG/ICL non-identifiability. Do not force a second component or declare ICL negligible.

stellar_mass_mapping.method_sigma_lineage: Cooke reports agreement within 30 percent with the independent Burke CLASH mass method.
stellar_mass_mapping.normalization_rule: Normalize the combined HST stellar light inside the measured 2*r_Petro aperture to the Cooke MAGPHYS mass; do not assign that mass to a single fitted component.
stellar_mass_mapping.icl_to_bcg_mass_to_light_ratio_prior: log-uniform from 0.5 to 2.0, reported as a project nuisance rather than a measured color-M/L calibration
stellar_mass_mapping.deprojection: spherical numerical Abel deprojection of the accepted PSF-deconvolved total-light posterior; preserve the BCG and ICL contributions separately when two components are identifiable
